title: PUT /books/{id} uses full-replace semantics
evidence: src/book_api.cpp:266 update() runs validate(), which requires title+author, so PUT is a full replace not a partial patch
suggestion: Acceptable for the spec (PUT = replace); note only if partial-update (PATCH) semantics are ever desired

title: Single-threaded blocking HTTP server
evidence: src/main.cpp:71 accept loop serves one connection at a time with Connection: close
suggestion: Fine for the task scope; would not scale to concurrent clients

title: sqlite3_prepare_v2 return codes not checked before step
evidence: src/book_api.cpp:190,205,256,270,282 prepare results are not checked; a prepare failure would leave st uninitialized before use
suggestion: Check the prepare_v2 return code and return 500 on failure; SQL is parameterized so no injection risk, this is robustness only
